name: v0.9.6
body:
### Mini player
- New mini player: a small window that takes the place of the main one. Open it with the new button in the footer (left of the lyrics button).
- It has the cover, title and artists, synced lyrics, playback controls, like, volume and progress. In a short window everything sits in one strip. In a taller one the cover fills the window, with three lines of lyrics, and the controls show on hover.
- The pin keeps the window above other apps' windows. It's on by default and not available on Wayland. The window remembers its size and position.

### Web remote
- Lyrics in the web remote, with line and word karaoke as on the desktop. Tap a line to jump there; after you scroll, the locate button brings back the current line.

### Albums
- The album header grows to fit its text, so a long title no longer pushes the artist, year and genres out of view. Titles wrap to up to three lines; a longer one is cut, with the full title in a tooltip.
- In a narrow window the album details move under the cover instead of squeezing into a thin column beside it.

### Other
- `.lrc` files saved with a byte order mark (common on Windows) no longer lose the timing of their first line.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.9.5...v0.9.6

name: v0.9.5
body:
### Equalizer
- New parametric equalizer in Tools -> Equalizer: up to 32 bands (peak, shelves, low and high pass). The preamp is automatic.
- Headphones: search the AutoEq measurements, preview the correction and load it. Loaded corrections become ordinary bands you can edit.
- Save bands as profiles, and import or export Equalizer APO / AutoEq `.txt` files.

### Windows and Linux
- New "Close to tray" switch in Settings -> General, off by default. When it's on, closing the window keeps Pawse playing in the system tray, and clicking the icon brings the window back.
- Full screen can now cover the whole screen, taskbar included, when the window is maximized: set Settings -> Appearance -> Cover view -> Full screen to Fullscreen. Windowed is the default and stays inside the window as before.

### Other
- Reopening the window (from the Dock on macOS or from the tray) returns to the screen you left. Back history and side panels stay as they were.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.9.4...v0.9.5

name: v0.9.4
body:
- Lyrics from the internet now come from several sources: BiniLyrics (Apple Music lyrics), LRCLIB and lrcmux. Pawse picks the best match.
- Albums are now grouped closer to how MusicBee does it (not identical): by title, and a differing album artist, MusicBrainz ID, release date or track year no longer splits an album unless track numbers clash.
- The album tag editor shows the year range when tracks of an album carry different release dates, and changes the year only if you edit the field.
- Lower resource use: fewer background threads, and a slow media server no longer holds up the rest of the app.
- Updated libraries.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.9.3...v0.9.4

name: v0.9.3
body:
### Lyrics
- New "Blur distant lines" switch in Settings -> Appearance -> Lyrics. Off by default. Thanks @zenassati (#15).
- New "Wave between lines" switch (on by default): lines follow the current one with a slight spring instead of scrolling together.

### Full screen
- Lyrics in Full screen now sit right on the cover: no panel background, and lines fade out at the top and bottom edges.
- The spectrum silhouette runs on under the lyrics panel, and the queue reaches up through the title bar.
- macOS: the window buttons hide and show together with the control bar.

### Playback
- New repeat mode "Stop after each track": after a track ends, the next one is cued paused and Play continues from there. It is the fourth state of the repeat button, also in the web remote.
- 24-bit ALAC files are no longer shown as 16-bit, and casting no longer sends them as 16-bit PCM. Thanks @Airsculpture (#17).

### Other
- Better experience with Medium and Large font sizes.
- Better performance and lower CPU use.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.9.2...v0.9.3

name: v0.9.2
body:
### Spectrum analyzer
- Cover view can now show a live spectrum of what's playing. Turn it on with the new button under Full screen.
- Four styles: On the cover (a curve along the bottom of the cover, in the accent color), Silhouette (across the whole window, the default), Zones and Analyzer.
- Style, tilt, smoothing and frame rate are in Settings -> Appearance -> Spectrum analyzer.
- It works on this computer's output and on AirPlay. It isn't available while casting to Chromecast or DLNA devices.

### Library
- Compilations whose tracks carry each song's own year are no longer split into one album per year. Thanks @Airsculpture (#13).
- Fewer split albums in other cases too: a stray space in the album title, or discs in "CD 1" / "Disc 2" folders without disc numbers.
- AIFF files (.aif, .aiff) in local folders are now added to the library.

### Window and volume
- The window remembers its size and position between launches, and on Windows it stays maximized if you closed it maximized.
- The mouse wheel changes the volume while the pointer is over the volume control. Thanks @Atmaweaponvi (#14).

### Lyrics
- New Bold and Italic buttons next to the text size in Settings -> Appearance -> Lyrics. Bold is on by default.
- The current line no longer turns bold when it becomes active, so lines don't re-wrap or jump.

### Casting
- AirPlay: older AirPlay 1 receivers that only accept encrypted audio (older shairport builds, for example) now play.
- When an AirPlay 2 speaker can't connect back to Pawse (usually because of a firewall on this computer), Pawse now explains it and shows how to fix it, as it already did for Chromecast and DLNA.
- Pawse now notices sooner when a Chromecast or DLNA device can't reach it. This includes renderers that report "playing" without ever fetching the track.

### Other
- Lower CPU use during karaoke and cover view animations: parts of the window that don't change are no longer redrawn every frame.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.9.1...v0.9.2

name: v0.9.1
body:
Fix Navidrome's "no artwork" vinyl showing over album covers in cover view (#11)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.9.0...v0.9.1

name: v0.9.0
body:
### Sound-based recommendations (off by default)
- Pawse can now analyse how your tracks sound and find ones that sound alike. Turn it on in Settings → General → Recommendations. The analysis runs locally on your graphics card in the background. Each track is analysed only once.
- New menu in the queue panel header: radio from the current track, mix other artists into the queue, and a Familiar / Any / New switch.
- When the queue runs out, it continues as a radio built from the last tracks you played. This has its own switch in the same group, on by default.
- Optional "Genres by sound": genres detected from the audio itself appear next to your tags in the album list, the album header and the Genres tab.

### Artists
- Artist pages now show a photo, years active, origin, top genres and members (from MusicBrainz and Deezer).
- Artists tab: new Grid layout, plus a Photo / Covers choice in View options.
- Album, artist and genre pages show a credit column when a track is credited to someone other than the album artist.

### Interface
- Click the cover in the footer to open and close cover mode.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.8.7...v0.9.0

name: v0.8.7
body:
- The header (tabs, search, buttons) now sits in the window title bar. You can switch back to the old layout in Settings → Appearance.
- Web remote: new Albums tab, and albums and artists can be sorted the same ways as in the app.
- The track artist / album artist switch moved from Settings to the "View options" menu on the Artists screen.
- macOS: the app now reopens reliably after an update.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.8.6...v0.8.7

name: v0.8.6
body:
- New "View options" button next to the search: sort, group and choose what's shown for the screen you're on. Thanks @zenassati (#9).
- Import playlists from Subsonic/Navidrome and Jellyfin servers with the new Import button on the Playlists screen. They're copied once and nothing is sent back. Thanks @endervad (#8).
- AI prompt: new "New releases" mode.
- Lyrics: the cache is cleared when fetching from the internet is turned off, and the karaoke fill is easier to see. Thanks @endervad (#6).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.8.5...v0.8.6

name: v0.8.5
body:
Streaming
- Added streaming to Chromecast, DLNA/UPnP and AirPlay (1 and 2) devices. Pick one in the audio device list in the header and the track keeps playing there from the same spot. Thanks @zenassati for pushing for this (#9).
- The device shows the track and cover. AirPlay remotes can pause and skip in pawse.
- The volume slider sets the device's volume. You can turn this off, or turn streaming off entirely, in Settings → General → Streaming.
- Linux: if a firewall is on (CachyOS enables ufw by default), allow ports 39831–39840 TCP and UDP. Otherwise devices show up in the list but don't play: `sudo ufw allow 39831:39840/tcp` and `sudo ufw allow 39831:39840/udp`.

Lyrics
- Lyrics from Subsonic and Jellyfin servers.
- Word-by-word karaoke for Enhanced LRC files and word-timed lyrics from Navidrome and Jellyfin. Thanks @endervad for the idea (#6).

Media servers
- Faster first sync: songs show up right away and covers load afterwards. Thanks @Superuser18 for the report (#4).
- Full-size server covers in cover view.
- Server tracks keep all their genres.

Also
- Torrents now start switched off. Turn them on in Settings → Library.
- Clicking the bit-perfect icon explains what's changing the sound (#7).
- (fixed) A broken cover image could stop a library scan or server sync.

name: v0.8.4
body:
- New Genres tab, off by default - turn it on in Settings -> Appearance. It lists every genre from your tags with album covers.
- Opus files (.opus) play now, from music folders and servers. Mono and stereo only.
- (fixed) The genre column in the Albums list could go empty when a track with a genre had no album.
- Clearer descriptions.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.8.3...v0.8.4

name: v0.8.3
body:
Sleep timer
- Set the automatic timer's hours and duration by typing them, and start a timer of any length (1 minute to 12 hours) from the Tools page.
- The fade-out length is adjustable now, from 5 seconds to 1 hour.

Library
- The "library is updating" notifications are gone. A small icon in the title bar shows scanning and syncing instead, and a check mark when it's done. Errors still appear as notifications.

Torrents
- (fixed). MacOS. A torrent with several hundred files could run out of open files and break the library scan next to it.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.8.2...v0.8.3

name: v0.8.2
body:
- The window now has a title, so taskbars and Alt+Tab on Windows and Linux show "Pawse" instead of an empty name.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.8.1...v0.8.2

name: v0.8.1
body:
Tools

A new Tools button in the title bar (off by default: turn it on in Settings).
- **Sleep timer**: pause playback after a set time or at the end of the current track. You can also set an automatic night timer in Settings → General: pick the hours and how long it should run, and pawse starts the timer itself when you play at night.
- **Covers**: finds covers for albums that don't have one (iTunes, MusicBrainz) and saves `cover.jpg` next to the files.
- **AI prompt**: turns your library and listening history into a prompt you can paste into any chatbot for recommendations.

Scrobbling
- **Rules before sending**: clean up tags on their way to Last.fm and other services, for example remove "Remastered" suffixes, or add your own find-and-replace rules. Your files and listening history keep the original text.
- **Scrobbling and likes for media servers**: plays and likes are now sent to Jellyfin and Subsonic servers too.

Media servers
- **DLNA / UPnP**: MiniDLNA, NAS and router media servers. Search the network or type the address by hand. A server that gets a new address is found again on its own.

Lyrics
- Switch between the .lrc file, the file's tags and LRCLIB for each track, or prefer LRCLIB by default.

Linux
- pawse now checks that PipeWire's ALSA plugin is installed. If it isn't, a window shows the install command for your distribution instead of playing to the wrong device.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.8.0...v0.8.1

name: v0.8.0
body:
Network sources

- **Subsonic** servers: Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic and other Subsonic-compatible servers. Their music appears in your library next to your local folders.
- **Jellyfin**: connect with your username and password, and your music library syncs into pawse.
- **Torrents**: add a magnet link or a .torrent file and listen right away, without downloading the whole thing first.
- Import favorites from a Subsonic or Jellyfin server into Liked.
- One track, several places: if the same album is both on disk and on a server, pawse treats it as one album and plays the local copy first.
- Every source shows whether it's online, and a server that goes down doesn't take your library with it. Everything you add lives in the new Settings → Library.

Network cache

- Tracks are saved to disk as you listen, so tracks you've already played start instantly and play offline. You can set a size limit or clear the cache at any time. Once the cache is over its limit, the oldest tracks are removed first.
- Save to cache: download a whole album or artist ahead of time, for example before a flight.
- Move to local library: turn a network album into real files in your music folder, with tidy names (Artist/Year - Album/NN - Title) and a cover. Likes, playlists and listening history stay attached to it.

Playlists and likes that don't get lost

- Likes and playlists now survive almost anything: a rescan, moving or renaming files, removing a folder and adding it back. pawse recognises the same track by its file and tags, even if it moved somewhere else.
- Unplugged drives are handled properly: when a folder or external drive is unavailable, its tracks are hidden until it's back. Before, they disappeared from playlists and likes. Playlists show them as unavailable in the meantime.
- Save the queue as a playlist in one click from the queue panel.

Also

- On Windows and Linux, pawse follows your system's default audio device when you switch it.
- Animations respect your system's "Reduce motion" setting.
- The audio device button in the header can be hidden (Settings → Appearance).
- UI polish across the app: panels, empty screens, onboarding.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.7.2...v0.8.0

name: v0.7.2
body:
Minor UI polish

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.7.1...v0.7.2

name: v0.7.1
body:
- **Theme that follows the cover art**: the interface takes its colour — and light or dark — from the album that's playing. Off by default, switch it on in Settings → Interface. Your theme still sets the contrast and keeps all of its text colours.
- **Customizable now playing** — the third line in the player is now a setting: tech specs (default), year, album (clickable) or nothing.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1

name: v0.7.0
body:
## Scrobbling

- **Several services at once**: Last.fm, Libre.fm, ListenBrainz (including a custom server) and a local CSV log. Each one is enabled and configured on its own.
- **Optional love sync**: liking a track in pawse also loves it on the service, and unliking removes it there.
- **Import loved tracks** from your profile into Liked - nothing is sent back.
- **Scrobble the first artist only**, instead of joining every performer into one name.
- Clearer sign-in: you can see that pawse is waiting for you to confirm in the browser, refresh an expired link, or cancel.

## Cover view and lyrics

- **Cover view is more flexible and looks better**.
- **Karaoke lyrics**: the current line fills as it plays and the rest dim - both can be tuned or turned off.
- **Background blur** is configurable now: blur intensity and how see-through the interface is over it.

## Also

- **Clear the queue** in one click.
- Updated UI engine, plus small improvements and fixes throughout the app.

## Known issue

On Linux, HDMI audio from AMD graphics can drop out while the picture on screen stays still. This is a driver bug — pawse keeps feeding an uninterrupted stream the whole time. As a workaround, keep a browser tab open with something moving on it: the pawse web remote works well, since its clock ticks every second and that keeps the machine from idling the display.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.6.0...v0.7.0

name: v0.6.0
body:
- New grid view for albums — browse your library as a wall of cover art. It's the new default; you can switch back to the list in Settings → Interface.
- Smoother, lighter scrolling through large libraries.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.5.8...v0.6.0

name: v0.5.8
body:
**Artists** — the Artists tab can now group by the `album artist` tag instead of each track's own `artist`, so an album stops splitting into "Band", "Band feat. Guest" and "Band/Someone". Tracks with no album artist fall back to their track artist, and on albums where nothing carries the tag Pawse works out the artist the tracks share. Pick the mode under Settings → Interface → Artists view.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.5.7...v0.5.8

name: v0.5.7
body:
**Linux** — Pawse now embeds AppImage update information and ships a `.zsync` file, so AppImage managers like [AM](https://github.com/ivan-hc/AM) and `AppImageUpdate` can update it themselves. When installed that way, Pawse's built-in updater steps aside instead of trying to overwrite itself and failing on permissions.


Thanks to @kazam0180 for the nudge (#2).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.5.6...v0.5.7

name: v0.5.6
body:
## Installation

- **macOS** — move `Pawse.app` to Applications and open it. If macOS blocks it, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click **Open Anyway**.
- **Windows** — in the SmartScreen dialog click **More info** → **Run anyway**.
- **Linux** — `chmod +x` the `.AppImage` and run it (recommended for smooth auto-updates), or install the `.deb`.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/popovpsk/pawse/compare/v0.5.5...v0.5.6
